images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. In a Noir detective city and neon subway service tunnel, the giant-scale city protector holds a wide-legged defensive stance over a collapsing miniature bridge. A luminous geometric portal ring throws wet reflections across the floor; the cat gives a tiny roar while a whale-like giant shadow looms behind. The shadow acts one second ahead, visibly warning of the bridge break. The impossible reflection then reveals the giant threat as a harmless projection shrinking into a playful light image. Include Bridge support rescue, the giant threat is revealed as a harmless projection, tiny roar, wide-legged defensive stance, impossible reflection, one decisive action, safe miniature construction, forced perspective, realistic weight and shadows. No text, logos, watermark, franchise symbols, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, duplicate limbs, or human features.
